method: Official entry point, fresh isolated Chrome contexts; natural MP4 completion and blocked sessionStorage, not only the lab/Skip path. Run separately from other browser suites because the prologue intentionally pauses on tab/window blur. Human visual approval pending.
checks: Fresh official browser: New Game exists and Continue is absent
New Astral: one difficulty click, natural video end, direct playable game, no title/play/continue detour and no duplicate character
Existing save: Continue appears; New Game starts the new Hunter and preserves the previous Astral progression/equipment
All sessionStorage I/O blocked: New Game still starts directly and survives natural video completion
Four target resolutions: touch on difficulty starts gameplay directly; no Continue in a fresh browser
A transient arrival-save failure stays in the start flow and retries the same hero directly, without title/Continue or replaying the video
